notes: Box score from the Grizzlies' 126–98 home win over the Golden State Warriors on Nov 19, 2026, from the Covers box score, with game details from the Associated Press (via the Daily Gazette and CBS Sports), Roundtable Sports (via Yahoo Sports), KMJ and 92.9 FM ESPN. All 126 Memphis points and all 98 Golden State points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (31–24–37–34 to 24–23–26–25) add up to both totals: 55–47 Memphis at the half (AP; KMJ) and 92–73 after three (Roundtable Sports). Team totals (threes 15 of 35 to 5 of 29, assists 34–20, points in the paint 62–54, fast-break points 14–7, offensive rebounds 16–18, free throws 17 of 17 to 27 of 32) are from the box score; the three-point and assist numbers match the written stories. Memphis's biggest lead, 34, is from the box score and the AP; Golden State never led (Roundtable Sports; the box score shows a biggest lead of 0). Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Thursday's games.

Jaylen Wells had 22 points on 8 of 10 shooting with 4 of 5 threes and 7 rebounds, and Cedric Coward had 19 with five threes (AP; KMJ; Roundtable Sports). Cam Spencer had 11 assists (KMJ). Memphis won its fifth straight (AP). Golden State, which finished its road trip 0-5, played without Stephen Curry (oblique) and Draymond Green (AP). Golden State's 10–0 run late in the second quarter cut it to 52–44 before the half (Roundtable Sports). Jerami Grant left early in the second quarter after landing awkwardly (AP). Memphis plays at Minnesota on Saturday, Nov 21 at 7 p.m. CT, 8:00 PM ET (Roundtable Sports; 92.9 FM ESPN).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Cedric Coward's 3-pointer with 4:40 left in the first half that made it 52–34 (Roundtable Sports; KMJ gives 52–34 with 4:40 left in the half); the AP has Memphis up 18 midway through the second quarter. The board shows Grizzlies +15 to +18 (49–34 to 52–34). The written stories don't describe the move, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from beyond the arc; the spot and the defender are not drawn to exact positions. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Memphis Grizzlies or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Cedric Coward's listed 6-foot-5 and 206 pounds with No. 23 (Wikipedia); no wingspan from a named measurement was found, so his arms use the default length. He is drawn in Memphis's home kit with the default figure look (no approved look yet). It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
